{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose an Alpine login prompt on localhost:6665 so telnet can connect and show the login prompt.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process launched from /app/alpine.iso","A launch log or receipt showing the QEMU command and background start"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU must remain running in the background","Host port 6665 must forward to the guest login service","Connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 must display a login prompt"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying file existence","Only verifying QEMU binary presence","Only verifying that port 6665 is open without a login prompt","Launching QEMU in the foreground so the task is not left running"],"verification_plan":["Inspect workspace for any helper scripts or prior receipts","Launch QEMU with user networking and hostfwd from 127.0.0.1:6665 to guest port 23 or serial console as needed","Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed","Keep the VM running after verification"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and background process","Receipt-backed probe evidence showing the login prompt on 127.0.0.1:6665"],"notes":["If the ISO boots to a serial console instead of telnetd, adjust QEMU console/forwarding so the login prompt is reachable on port 6665."]},{"type":"working_checklist","items":["Inspect visible files and any prior receipts for launch details","Determine whether qemu-system-x86_64 or an equivalent QEMU binary is available","Start the VM detached/backgrounded with logging","Probe localhost:6665 for the login prompt and preserve the running VM"]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"cd /app && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort","timeout":120000}]}
